identity.name: Enviro Infra Engineers
identity.industry: Water/Wastewater EPC + O&M (STP/CETP/WTP, AMRUT/Namami Gange) — Environmental Infra; now diversifying into Renewables (Solar/Wind/BESS)

summary.oneLiner: Pure-play water/wastewater EPC missed FY26 revenue guidance (35%→7.5% growth) on slow order finalization + projects stuck in design stage, but pivots hard into renewables (BESS/wind/solar, now ~35-40% of order book) with all-time-high INR6,814 cr total order book giving ~24-month visibility — execution conversion (not order book) is the swing factor, and a global commodity crisis trims FY27 margin guidance.

one-line thesis: Pure-play water/wastewater EPC missed FY26 revenue guidance (35%→7.5% growth) on slow order finalization + projects stuck in design stage, but pivots hard into renewables (BESS/wind/solar, now ~35-40% of order book) with all-time-high INR6,814 cr total order book giving ~24-month visibility — execution conversion (not order book) is the swing factor, and a global commodity crisis trims FY27 margin guidance.
financial scorecard: Q4 FY26: Revenue INR427.3 cr (+8.8% YoY); EBITDA INR79.9 cr, margin 18.7% (weakest margins of year); PAT INR54.3 cr, PAT margin 12.4%.
FY26 (full year): Revenue INR1,145.6 cr (+7.5% YoY — MISSED ~35% guidance); EBITDA INR276.8 cr (+3.4%), margin 24.2%; PAT INR188.4 cr, margin 15.9%.

Order book (all-time high): INR6,814 cr total = Water/WW execution INR2,733 cr + Water/WW O&M INR951 cr + Renewable execution INR2,051 cr + Renewable O&M/IPP INR1,079 cr. Execution-only OB = INR4,800 cr (Water/WW ~INR2,700 cr + Renewables ~INR2,050 cr).
Book-to-bill: ~4.2x on execution OB / ~6x total OB vs FY26 revenue — gives clear 2-year (FY27+FY28) visibility.
Net debt: Total debt INR422 cr (long-term/term-loan-HAM INR250 cr + short-term/CC ~INR175 cr). D/E = 0.34x. Finance cost DIPPED YoY.

Working capital: STRETCHED to 166 days (vs 95-100 target). Split: inventory 11d, receivables 53d (improved), UBR 195d (blowout), creditors 92d. Cause: AMRUT funds not released (Chhattisgarh, MP, Rajasthan, Haryana, Punjab) → cannot raise GST invoices.

Cash flow: OCF pre-tax ~breakeven (+INR4 lakh); post-tax INR-63 cr (negative, partly from 15-yr service-concession/HAM receivables booked to OCF per accounting policy). Mgmt calls "adjusted OCF" positive.

One-offs / drags in Q4: ~INR100-120 cr renewable IPP revenue at ~0% margin; ECL provision INR10 cr (Ind AS); depreciation up ~INR25 cr (new construction equipment); employee cost up to ~6% of revenue (+~1.5pp, projects sat in design stage so cost booked w/o revenue). Cost of manufacturing actually DOWN ~1pp.
guidance (critical): FY27 revenue: ~INR2,000 cr (vs INR1,145 cr FY26 — implies ~75% growth, but mgmt frames as ~42% conversion of INR4,800 cr execution OB, deliberately conservative). Split: Water/WW ~INR1,350 cr + Renewables ~INR650 cr.
FY27 PAT: INR270-280 cr; PAT margin ~13.5-14% (blended).
FY27 EBITDA margin: LOWERED to 21-22% (from earlier 22-24%) due to global commodity/geopolitical crisis (1-2pp hit; price-variation clauses cover only part).
FY27 order inflow target: at least INR2,500 cr of fresh orders.
FY28: 35-40% topline growth implied; ~INR2,500-2,800 cr revenue from remaining current OB — "FY27 & FY28 visibility clear on current OB."
Q1 FY27 color: Better than Q1 FY26 (~INR250 cr) despite global crisis; no number given.
Renewables/BESS margin: BESS EPC ~10% PAT; blended renewables 10-12% PAT.
order book & pipeline: Execution OB INR4,800 cr; total OB INR6,814 cr (incl. O&M + IPP).

Q4 additions: BUIDCO Bihar INR348 cr; Pune+Nashik sanitation (Swachh Bharat) INR824 cr; 4 NTPC BESS EPC projects (930 MWh, ~INR1,070 cr — UP/Assam/Karnataka/Telangana); acquired 150 MWh BESS project in Bihar.
Bid pipeline: ~INR1,200 cr bids submitted + ~INR5,000 cr of projects of interest yet to bid.
FY26 starting OB was only ~INR1,200 cr; converted INR1,145 cr (~95% conversion rate) — but revenue still missed because new wins stayed in design stage.
segment / subsidiary detail: Water/WW EPC (core): STP (per-MLD INR1-1.5 cr), CETP (INR2-15 cr/MLD, industry-dependent), WTP (INR30-50 lakh/MLD). Design = 2-5% of turnkey value. Mostly EPC; some STPs on HAM. Completed marquee projects: 100 MLD STP Jodhpur (IFAS + biogas power + UF), 55 MLD STP Varanasi (solar-on-reactor, India-first, NMCG-recognized), 25 MLD CETP Sarigam, 30 MLD STP Bhiwadi — raising pre-qualification for larger/complex plants.
O&M (Water/WW): INR951 cr OB; 3-5% of revenue; higher margin than execution; growing in absolute terms YoY.

Renewables (1 yr old): Execution OB INR2,051 cr + O&M/IPP INR1,079 cr. NTPC BESS EPC (incl. EHV transformers / HT transmission lines self-executed). Wind EPC via Suyog Urja Ltd (acquired) — serves A-to-AAA-rated private clients. Solar assets + IPP. Reported as separate company; segmental revenues to be disclosed separately going forward.
growth verticals / optionality: BESS: positioning as first-mover in India's 90 GW battery-storage pipeline; 930 MWh NTPC + 150 MWh Bihar.
Wind EPC (Suyog) into private A/AAA clients — de-risks govt receivables.
Desalination optionality: MIDC CETP-ZLD textile project (UF/RO, one of India's biggest) builds pre-qualification to enter desalination (open to JVs).
Water re-use / BOT: treated CETP/ZLD water recirculated to industry could become revenue stream / BOT model (preliminary).
T&D EPC: NOT entering soon, but BESS work (EHV/HT lines) gives pre-quals; possible future diversification (AI-driven power demand cited).
HAM/IPP annuity income — decent IRR, O&M absolute profitability rising.
margins & cost dynamics: FY26 EBITDA margin 24.2% (mgmt says no real compression once normalized; Q4 18.7% optical due to 0-margin IPP revenue + ECL + depreciation + design-stage employee cost). FY27 EBITDA guided 21-22% (cut 1-2pp for commodity inflation). Price-variation clauses in most contracts offset PART of cost rises, not all. BESS EPC ~10% PAT (lithium-ion import cost pressure — deferring battery procurement, doing BOS/civil/electrical first).
capex / expansion: Light. Per new project ~INR4-5 cr equipment (reuse first). Total FY27 capex ~INR20-30 cr, "not a bigger amount." Watch: execution slippage — FY26 miss was ~INR100 cr each from renewables and wastewater stuck in design/approval (Bangalore x2, MIDC CETP-ZLD).
capital allocation: D/E 0.34x; max comfort 1:1 consolidated (incl. renewable development projects). Finance cost down YoY. Asset monetization/offloading planned if leverage runs heavy (has solar/IPP assets). Disciplined, complementary diversification stance.
risks & watch-items: Govt-payment cycle: AMRUT funds not released (5-6 states) → UBR ballooned to 195d, WC to 166d; recurring (Jal Jeevan last yr, AMRUT this yr). Some releases now confirmed (Chhattisgarh; coming for Rajasthan/Haryana/MP).
Order finalization delays / re-bidding: elongated bid evaluation; a Nov-Dec L1 project went to re-bid (timeline lost, neutral outcome).
Commodity / geopolitical crisis: raw-material/lithium-ion cost spike → 1-2pp margin pressure.
Guidance credibility: missed FY26 35% guidance; investor explicitly asked for realistic targets — FY27 deliberately conservative.
OCF post-tax negative (-INR63 cr); concentration on central-govt-funded projects (de-risking via NTPC B2B + private wind).
management quality / tone: Candid on the miss — admitted revenue guidance not met, explained design-stage cost build-up, ECL/depreciation/IPP drags transparently. Conservative reframing of FY27 (42% conversion vs raw 75% growth). Took investor criticism on guidance realism gracefully. Confident but measured on renewables; disciplined leverage and capex discipline. Slightly defensive on "no margin compression" framing.
non-obvious takeaways: The headline "+75% FY27 growth" is an artifact of a tiny FY26 base; mgmt insists on viewing it as ~42% OB conversion — the real number to track is conversion rate, not growth %.
FY26 ~95% order-to-order conversion but revenue still missed — the bottleneck is design/approval-to-execution lag, not order wins.
Renewables grew from ~INR12 cr (till Dec) to INR117 cr in Q4 alone — entire FY26 renewable revenue (INR129 cr) was back-ended and ~0-margin (IPP), structurally depressing Q4 optics.

UBR at 195 days (not receivables — receivables actually improved to 53d) is the true working-capital story; it's GST-invoice timing tied to govt fund release, so a release wave could sharply unwind WC.
Company is quietly building T&D/transmission pre-quals via BESS execution — optionality not yet priced.

qoq change log: Q4 FY26 (this): All-time-high total OB INR6,814 cr (exec INR4,800 cr). FY26 revenue INR1,145 cr (+7.5%, MISSED 35% guidance); FY26 EBITDA margin 24.2%, PAT INR188 cr. Q4 weakest margins (EBITDA 18.7%) on 0-margin IPP + ECL + depreciation + design-stage costs. Renewables now ~35-40% of OB (BESS 930+150 MWh from NTPC/Bihar; Suyog Urja wind-EPC acquired). WC blew out to 166d (UBR 195d) on AMRUT fund delays. FY27 guide: rev ~INR2,000 cr, PAT INR270-280 cr, EBITDA cut to 21-22%, order inflow ≥INR2,500 cr. D/E 0.34x.

themes.title: Water & environmental-infra EPC
themes.need: AMRUT, Namami Gange and Jal Jeevan still define the pipeline, but Q1FY27 put a number on the funding freeze. WPIL's consolidated revenue rose 32% to INR 501cr while STANDALONE collapsed 37% to INR 115cr as domestic Jal Jeevan invoicing froze, with INR 300-350cr of JJM receivables pending (mostly West Bengal, some MP) and nil received in the quarter - management expects substantial inflow only in Q2/H2. The offsetting discovery is that the theme has quietly become international: WPIL's overseas revenue roughly doubled to INR 386cr, about 77% of consolidated, on PCI Africa's first full execution quarter plus Gruppo Aturia MENA demand, lifting consolidated EBITDA margin to 15.04%. EIEL carries an all-time-high order book (~6x revenue); WABAG on desalination/technology; JISLJALEQS/JISLDVREQS and MAHEPC add micro-irrigation and water-efficiency equipment; EMSLIMITED/SPMLINFRA/JASH/DENTA/ELECTCAST/AWHCL add sewerage, control equipment and ductile-iron piping. Execution conversion, not order intake, remains the binding constraint.
themes.driver: JJM/AMRUT fund releases unlocking billing (WPIL's INR 300-350cr receivable is the tracer); FY27 order inflow; desalination + NTPC BESS EPC ramp; international Africa/MENA execution.
